parameter_matrix.note: Synchronous rectification eliminates external Schottky diode loss and PCB area.
Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Provides transient overshoot margin above nominal DC supply bus.
Fixed-output variants save divider BOM; adjustable parts allow arbitrary rail tuning up to switch BVdss limits.
For boost/switch-limited converters, usable Iout ≈ Isw × (Vin / Vout) × η minus half ripple ΔIL/2.
Dominates light-load efficiency and standby battery runtime.
Higher fsw shrinks inductor footprint; lower fsw reduces switching losses & high-band EMI.
Check datasheet efficiency curve at your exact Vin/Vout/Iout operating point.
Ensure inductor Isat exceeds worst-case peak switch current by >= 20–30%.
Any Vref discrepancy requires recalculating feedback divider R1/R2.
Lower θJA improves continuous load thermal headroom on compact 2-layer PCBs.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS610994DRVR uses WSON-6 (6-pin, DRV) while TPS613221ADBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs SW), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (FB vs NC), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (VIN vs NONE). Soldering TPS613221ADBVR onto a TPS610994DRVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (WSON-6: GND vs SOT-23-5: NONE); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 30% (TPS610994DRVR: 1116 kHz p.16 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 1600 kHz p.9); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 165% higher on TPS613221ADBVR (TPS610994DRVR: 71.7 °C/W p.4 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 189.7 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS610994DRVR (Texas Instruments, WSON-6) and TPS613221ADBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs SW), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (FB vs NC), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (VIN vs NONE); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs SW), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (FB vs NC), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT). Power-stage deltas: boost (sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency 1116 kHz (p.16) vs 1600 kHz (p.9) (1.4x ratio), typical inductor 2.2 µH (p.4) vs 2.2 µH (p.4), output mode fixed vs fixed, and package θJA 71.7 vs 189.7 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS610994DRVR "Pin 3 (FB) MUST Connect to GND on Fixed 3.3 V TPS610994 (Opposite of TPS61221)" (p.3) and TPS613221ADBVR "No Enable (EN) Pin and No True Load Disconnect" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose TPS610994DRVR when light-load battery standby needs 1 µA Iq; choose TPS613221ADBVR when higher switch current capacity (1200 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
